technical_validation.evidence: A fresh clone of the remote branch passed generator determinism, all variant contracts, lab execution, seven chart outputs, the clean-worktree check, and the manifest checksum check.

validation.determinism: same variant and seed produce byte-identical CSV files
validation.different_seed: seed 731 produces a different file that preserves the real variant contract

hidden_process_visual_preview.observation: The admitted density has a lower-stay process and a distinct boarded mode near 782 minutes; pooling weakens the longer-stay mode.

known_issues: The dataset is designed for instruction and is not evidence about any hospital, patient population, or intervention.
Acuity and age group are assigned independently of length of stay, so they should not be used for clinical inference.
The model omits staffing, occupancy, seasonality, transfers, censoring, and other real emergency department processes.
Technical execution has been tested on Windows; human faculty, clinical, accessibility, and independent-instructor reviews are pending.
